chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying:

“ʿAlī عليه السلام, when he found two men under one coverlet, would administer the hadd punishment to them; and when he found two women under one coverlet, he would administer the hadd punishment to them.”

key_terms.أَخَذَ: found or apprehended in the described state
key_terms.الرَّجُلَيْنِ: the two men involved in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَتَيْنِ: the two women involved in the ruling
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose legal practice is being reported
key_terms.لِحَافٍ: a shared coverlet or bedding under which persons are found together

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shiʿi hadith on two men or two women being found in one coverlet?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning two men or two women found together in one coverlet. It reflects the seriousness of illicit sexual-related conduct in Islamic jurisprudence and the role of the Imam in enforcing legal boundaries.
